children: IQVIA intends to raise $2.0 billion through senior notes due 2034 priced at 6.375% to refinance near-term debt.
IQVIA's subsidiary plans a $2.0B offering of senior notes due March 15, 2034 to raise gross proceeds.
Notes priced at 6.375% interest, payable semi‑annually on Mar 15 and Sep 15 beginning Mar 15, 2027.
Proceeds will redeem in full the Issuer's 5.000% Notes due 2026 and repay part of the revolver balance.
Issuance expected on or about Sep 23, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and private placement rules.
